subject: Marine Works - Diving operations - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Diving operations - Vancouver Harbour
Diving operations at Chief Dan George west buoy in the vicinity of 49 18.133N 122 58.561W.
 
From 1300UTC October 30 until 2300UTC October 30 2026.
Mariners are requested to stay a minumum of 100 meters from the buoy for diver safety.
Vessels monitoring VHF Channels 16, 12, and 69.
 
minimum wash.
